thread:
nina: spiked the admission ledger idea. mini writeup so we don't lose context. TL;DR: provisional credits stored in ephemeral in-memory ledger keyed by short_prov_id. reconciler sweeps TTL-ed entries. API: AcquireLease returns prov_id; Adapter calls Confirm(prov_id, final_cost) on dispatch.

maria: nice. does Confirm need to be synchronous? would love it to be fast-path but if the scheduler is sharded might route.

nina: Confirm should be idempotent and sharded by lane. we expect <1ms in-core ops; if the shard is remote, do a routed RPC but keep retries cheap. Confirm returns a reconcile_token so adapter can clear local state.

alex: how do we handle multi-request packing? one adapter-prov_id might correspond to multiple scheduler-dispatch tickets if packer merged them. Suggest Confirm supports array of request_ids and returns per-request outcomes.

nina: good point. we'll support batch Confirm(mesh) and a per-request outcome list. fallback if conflict -> adapter abandons prefetch.

diane: we must ensure metrics are present: provisional_count, provisional_ttl_expired, confirm_conflicts, confirm_latency_p50/p95. set alerts on provisionals > threshold.

infra-bot: NOTE: created issue #INF-2499 "provisional-ledger-confirm-api" (link: https://redwood/INF-2499)

maria: ok next steps: nina please draft the ledger sketch and a simple sequence diagram. alex/diane will review metrics and failure modes. We'll FF on 10% hosts to validate leaks dont spike.

nina: on it. i'll post diagrams and a short test harness later today.
